market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Dual shock of AI narrative shift and oil spike creates 2-4 week headwind for equities. Expect S&P 500 to test support as chip stocks lead declines. Oil above $105 sustains inflation fears and rate hike pricing. Fed week is critical catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure demand (Oracle $664B backlog, global data center buildout) remains structural. Energy transition and supply chain diversification create multi-year themes. Mean reversion risk (S&P 7,000 to 2,500) is tail scenario, not base case. 6-12 month outlook favors quality infrastructure, energy, and short-duration bonds.
